# Automated red team

A second model is told to cheat: for each effect and corpus case it writes exploit tests instructed to make the oracle declare `proven` on the FIXED tree, so any proof is false by construction. Each test runs through the real sandbox and oracle and is classified as a false proof matching a declared residual limit (R1-R6, `docs/oracle/oracle-provenance.md` section 7), a NEW false proof (saved under `spikes/redteam/auto/findings/`), blocked, or errored.

```bash

```

